issues.title: Web scene MSAA remains forced single-sample
issues.reproduction: Fire Lab requests AA but Edge reports one sample on capable hardware.
issues.rootCause: Offscreen scene target has no multisample resolve path.
issues.dispositionRationale: Implement bounded actual-capability selection and native-like HDR/LDR/heat resolve without framebuffer feedback.

issues.title: Canvas keyboard and browser shortcut ownership
issues.reproduction: Source audit finds window-wide key handler without focused editable-target exclusion.
issues.rootCause: Canvas ownership is not checked consistently.
issues.dispositionRationale: Shared Web glue now gates keyboard ownership by focused program surface, preserves browser/text shortcuts, clears held keys on surface blur and provides a focus-revealed Full Screen button. Focused generated-runtime VM checks pass, including Ctrl+Arrow navigation, repeat, console transitions, touch-owner isolation and fullscreen state. Actual Chrome/Edge interaction and installed VSIX validation remain required; not closed by VM evidence alone.

issues.title: Current calibration JSON browser import/download bridge absent
issues.reproduction: Browser exposes a Windows JSON path but cannot use Explorer/native synchronizer.
issues.rootCause: No validated browser transfer workflow for existing snapshots.
issues.dispositionRationale: Saved schema-2 JSON download implemented; both shared exports pass canonical/native round-trips and actual Edge Arin download matches. Generic UTF-8 file pickers compile on both targets and native dialogs round-trip exact bytes. In-Viewer atomic JSON import and real browser import-file selection remain unverified/incomplete; no automatic browser-to-repository writes.

issues.title: Canonical pose adjustments absent on fresh Web Viewer
issues.reproduction: Sin observed Arin without saved pose adjustments in Web.
issues.rootCause: Only models/effect assets were published; native Save Data is separate from browser origin storage.
issues.dispositionRationale: Declare generated canonical SMKF defaults, reuse authoritative serializer/decoder, prefer existing saves. Native and actual Edge byte-level fixture pass; Attack shows 13 saved keys.

issues.title: Persistent Data failure atomicity and recovery
issues.reproduction: Source audit: memory save updates before persistent write; load can throw on denied/corrupt storage.
issues.rootCause: Storage failure can leave memory/disk disagreement and lacks previous-good recovery.
issues.dispositionRationale: Optional shared Data Status, native/Web backup recovery and transactional Viewer Save/Undo are implemented in 2cb6c523a43bb71e8f113b93bf426b1f43db1f1e. Native filesystem denial/corruption and disposable Web VM checks pass, including exact Viewer console parity. Actual Chrome/Edge disposable probes retain bytes across refresh and tab reopen. The subsequent VSIX retry installed and hash-verified the payload after Visual Studio closed. Viewer-origin save/reload and final import/recovery workflow evidence remain required; not a final gate pass.

issues.title: Shadow compare linear filtering browser warning
issues.reproduction: Firefox diagnostic warned shadow sampling depended on implementation-specific filtering.
issues.rootCause: LINEAR hardware compare combined with explicit PCF.
issues.dispositionRationale: Use NEAREST comparisons with existing explicit PCF. Current Edge has no warning; Firefox is not claimed passed.

issues.title: Lightning Ultra GPU pool rejected on Web
issues.reproduction: Real Edge Ultra showed Basic backend and zero GPU pool despite capable thermal GPU.
issues.rootCause: Web capped GPU/Auto at CPU reference maximum 8192 instead of native 16384.
issues.dispositionRationale: GPU/Auto now 16384, CPU remains8192 and scene32768. VM admission/rejection checks and real Edge backend2/pool16384/GPUbytes3932160 pass.

issues.title: Web Euler rotation signs reverse arena facing and shield corrections
issues.reproduction: Old Web produced 30 socket-reference mismatches while native passed; user observed facing and shield defects.
issues.rootCause: Web Euler axis signs differed from native X-then-Y-then-Z transform convention.
issues.dispositionRationale: Focused native/Web normal and PBR fallback tests pass; visible Edge poses corrected. Sin reported Arin looks good and stopped further screenshot comparisons.

issues.title: Repeated Viewer tab switches reload reusable character assets
issues.reproduction: Sin observed long frozen switches in deployed Chrome on PC and Mac; shared source destroyed last actor assets and Web fetched model bytes again.
issues.rootCause: Scene teardown also released reusable model resources; encoded Web model/image bytes were not retained after their last decoded owner.
issues.dispositionRationale: Implemented bounded optional immutable asset retention in shared Character3D and page-local encoded Web reuse. Native and generated-Web ownership tests and real native/Chrome four-tab switching pass. Working-copy changes are awaiting milestone commit; new deployed/Mac timing acceptance is not claimed. First visits still load and actor/VFX instances are intentionally recreated.

issues.title: Browser context menu covers Viewer secondary-pointer reset

issues.rootCause: Canvas contextmenu default was not canceled.
issues.dispositionRationale: Canvas-only prevention; real Edge reset still works with no menu. Mobile-controls fixture verifies outside menu remains unaffected.
